items.approach: Create sycl_common + sycl_utils replacing llmc/cuda_common.h + llmc/cuda_utils.cuh. Packed128 -> sycl::vec alignment 16 with load128/store128 as vectorized global loads; __ldcs/__stcs/__stcg/__ldg hints dropped (SYCL has no streaming hints). warpReduceSum/Max via sycl::reduce_over_group or shift_group_left/permute_group_by_xor on sycl::sub_group without assuming size 32. blockReduce via sycl::local_accessor<float> + group_barrier. bf16/half via sycl::ext::oneapi::bfloat16/sycl::half. cudaMallocConditionallyManaged/cudaMallocManaged -> sycl::malloc_device with fallback sycl::malloc_shared. streams/events -> in-order sycl::queue + sycl::event. Prove simple kernels copy_and_cast_kernel and global_sum_single_block_kernel first.

plan.summary: Migrate foundation llmc/cuda_utils.cuh first (all kernels include it) then Tier1 pointwise kernels easiest to hardest (gelu, global_norm, fused_classifier, adamw, encoder, layernorm), then Tier3 library items (matmul oneMath+manual GELU epilogue, attention fallback, zero oneCCL, train orchestration with oneMath/oneDNN/oneCCL), finally test harness. Two ordering exceptions are intentional: Tier2 foundation precedes Tier1 dependents, and Tier1 test runs last as end-to-end validation.
